purpose: Teach: 三宮/松平/トゥ/吉井/岩本/半田/栗山/入江

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、神戸三宮の地震被害復興史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the post-earthquake reconstruction history of Kobe Sannomiya, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured curiosity. Opens with the student's name at a gentle pitch. Thoughtful pause before the question—genuinely interested in what she'll correct. Patient, observant teacher tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、徳川松平家の系譜研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote mine on genealogical research of the Tokugawa and Matsudaira clans.
lines.style: Clear, direct correction. Steady voice with quiet confidence—not defensive, just factual. Eyes steady, ready to move forward. A student who knows her own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 英語のトゥ、つまり「to」音素の音韻論を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Then you wrote your paper on the phonological study of the English 'tu' sound—the 't' phoneme, I mean.
lines.style: Gentle correction-phrasing. Warm but uncertain—checking her own memory. Slight self-correction on the 'tu' clarification. Reflective, as if thinking aloud with the student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治家吉井英勝氏の議会活動研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I actually wrote on parliamentary activity research of Politician Yoshii Hidekatsu.
lines.style: Patient but firm correction. Not irritated, just clarifying her actual topic. Slight emphasis on the name to anchor what she actually studied. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 岩本徹三のゼロ戦操縦の戦記を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper was on the war record of Iwamoto Tetsuzo's Zero fighter piloting tactics.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate phrasing. Teacher is clearly testing a theory or checking notes. Pauses slightly before the specific name. Thoughtful, almost apologetic in tone—recognizing she might be off again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、電気工学の半田、つまり半田付けの工学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, mine was on the engineering research of soldering in electrical engineering—the solder joint itself.
lines.style: Calm but definitive correction. Unhurried, explaining without condescension. A student comfortable being precise about technical terminology. Slight emphasis on the technical term.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 野球の栗山英樹監督の采配研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper addressed the tactical research of baseball manager Kuriyama Hideki's strategy.
lines.style: Slower tempo, almost apologetic. This is the third or fourth miss—the teacher sounds genuinely curious now, less certain. Slight smile in the voice, acknowledging the pattern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、海岸の入江、つまり入江地形の海洋学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote on the oceanographic study of coastal cove formations—the inlet geography itself.
lines.style: Final correction, warmer now. Student sounds almost amused at this point. Clear, unhurried. A small note of relief that they're reaching the end. Gentle landing.
